description.description: These frames were captured from a video of a Tesla's central screen, which displays dashcam footage. The dashcam shows several motorcycles speeding and weaving through traffic on a freeway. In the first frame, one motorcyclist speeds between two other vehicles, while other motorcyclists follow behind. The subsequent frames show the motorcycles moving further away into the distance at high speeds.
